At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Developer with expertise in building robust and scalable solutions to join Trustpilot’s Go-to-Market Technology department. This role will be pivotal in executing large strategic projects within our Salesforce platform, collaborating across our commercial, marketing, and customer service teams.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in modern Salesforce development, a proactive approach to operational excellence, and a deep understanding of code quality and process automation. You will work closely with the wider Salesforce team to ensure our solutions are performant, secure, and aligned with technical standards. Familiarity with CPQ or middle-layer pricing and quoting platforms that bridge CRM and billing systems (e.g., Revenue Cloud) is desirable.

What you’ll be doing:

• Salesforce Development: Design, develop, and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and other programmatic capabilities to meet the needs of the GTM Tech team.

• Automation: Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and automation, ensuring adherence to best practices and optimal performance.

• Technical Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of project features, from solution design and cross-functional problem-solving to final deployment.

• Integrations: Integrate Salesforce with internal and external systems using APIs and various integration patterns.

• Peer Review: Participate in code reviews and ensure solutions align with the broader Salesforce ecosystem strategy and coding standards.

• Best Practices: Implement Salesforce best practices, focusing on scalable code, data integrity, security, and performance optimization.

• Troubleshooting: Support incident management and processes through custom development and technical troubleshooting.

• Requirement Translation: Collaborate with stakeholders and business analysts to translate complex requirements into technical specifications and high-quality solutions.

• DevOps: Utilize and contribute to CI/CD processes and version control workflows to support a high velocity of work.

• Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for Salesforce customizations and integrations.

• Mentorship: Provide guidance and technical coaching to Administrators and junior developers to support their skills development.

Who you are:

Technical Skills

• Certifications: Minimum of Platform Developer I certification; Platform Developer II or Architect-track certifications are highly valued.

• Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer, demonstrating a proven track record of developing and deploying complex programmatic solutions.

• Modern Tooling: Extensive experience with Salesforce Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Apex. Experience with Agentforce and Data360 is a plus.

• Code Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency in SOQL/SOSL, platform events, and asynchronous processing.

• Integrations: Strong understanding of Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk) and integration patterns.

• Security: Deep understanding of Salesforce security models (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules) and their programmatic implications.

• Tools: Proficiency in using developer tools like VS Code, Salesforce CLI, and Git for version control.

Collaboration & Mindset

• Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to conduct technical discussions and explain complex solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

• A proactive and flexible mindset, ready to embrace new challenges in a dynamic development environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on writing maintainable, scalable code.

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Pension and life insurance

• Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7, Employee Assistance Plan

• Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme

• Central office location complete with pool table, a gaming corner, coffee bars and all the snacks and refreshments you can ask for

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, Trustie Community activities, and team socials.

• Access to over 4,000 deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness, cinema discounts, and more.

• Independent financial advice and free standard professional mortgage broker advice

• Talent acceleration programs: Fast-track your career with our tailored development programs designed to support growth at whatever stage of your career

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

• Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:
Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

• Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:
Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

• Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
• Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
• International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
• Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.
How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program. 

• Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment. 
• Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
• Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.
             

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of strong finance acumen, operational excellence and consulting experience(preferred), with the ability to lead change across diverse geographies and teams.

Facilitate process design workshops with cross-functional stakeholders, and define, document and maintain comprehensive process maps and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency, efficiency and compliance across regions and teams.

• Training & Change Management: Design and deliver training programs for regional finance teams to support the adoption of new processes and compliance with global standards.

• Continuous Improvement: Establish a culture of continuous improvement by regularly soliciting feedback, conducting process reviews, analyzing performance data and introducing best practices.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in finance operations, including at least 2–3 years in a management consulting or finance transformation role.

• Proven experience leading global finance initiatives in a matrixed, multinational environment.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority.

• Experience with ERP systems including Microsoft Dynamics 365, and finance automation tools.

• Proficiency in process mapping tools, such as Microsoft Visio.

• Familiarity with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

• Experience working in a shared services or global business services (GBS) environment.

Key Competencies

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving

You will contribute to global standards with practical relevance to local teams, work across finance, business operations and technology, and help strengthen the foundations for scalable ways of working. The role offers exposure to varied business challenges and the opportunity to see your analysis become clearer processes, stronger controls and less rework.

Every year, European governments spend billions on mobility: subsidies, contracts, licences, public transport. Most of that money is spent with no clear idea of what it buys for society.

We're building the tech layer that changes that.

What we do

Impact Market builds MIMA, the Mobility Impact Market. On our platform, cities and transport authorities incentivise mobility operators (bike share, e-scooters, car-pooling, car sharing, bike leasing) for trips according to their benefit to society: a car trip replaced, emissions avoided, space and congestion saved, health improved, a neighbourhood connected. By estimating the socio-economic impact of each trip, we design smart incentives that get the most social value out of public funds.

The idea is much bigger than mobility: governments paying for the outcomes they want, with the evidence to back it up. Mobility is our first market, and we intend to move into other areas of public spending.

Where we are

• 
Funded with 12+ months runway

• 
Several paying public-sector clients

• 
A production platform (prod + staging), with live trip and rider-survey data from operators flowing in since August 2026

• 
A team of 3. You'd be number 4.

The role

You'll be our first technical hire and will lead product and engineering. For now that means hands fully dirty: you write the code. No agencies, no outsourcing.

• 
Own the platform. Rust, Postgres, cloud, our RiderSurvey API, and the data pipelines from operators. You'll inherit a working MVP and decide what to keep, what to rebuild and what to build next.

• 
Make the big calls, including the language. We chose Rust deliberately: we think a strict compiler and type system are the right guardrails for building fast with AI. If you have a better argument for something else, convince us.

• 
Be AI-native. We expect you to use AI seriously in coding and every other technical task. That's how a team of four does the work of fifteen.

• 
Build agents that run the company with us, for account management, client reporting and forecasting.

• 
Grow into the science. Together with a future R&D lead, you'll work on the statistical significance of measured impacts and on forecasting how markets respond to incentives.

• 
Shape the product with the founders and our clients. You'll be in the room with transport authorities, not behind a ticket queue.

You

• 
Have minimum 4 years of relevant experience shipping production software, ideally backend or data-heavy systems

• 
Senior and still love writing code every day? Even better.

• 
Know Rust, or are genuinely motivated to go deep in it (not just "willing"). (We are not dogmatic about Rust, but we have a working platform built with care, so changing direction would take strong conviction.)

• 
Already build with AI tools daily and have opinions about how to do it well

• 
Are comfortable with data: SQL, pipelines, and an appetite for statistics and forecasting

• 
Take ownership when things are ambiguous, and like it when nobody tells you how

• 
Care about the mission. You don't need to have read our founder's book, The Next Democracy, but its core ideas about how citizens and governments could work together - is fundamental to what we do. If they don’t excite you, this probably isn't the right fit.

Bonus points for experience in mobility or transport, govtech, causal inference or experimentation, or privacy-by-design and GDPR.

About Photoncycle

Solar panels make plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that for households. We store energy from the summer sun, so that the it can be used all winter. When there’s excess energy, we sell the surplus to the grid, where it helps balance supply and demand. Households pay a fixed monthly fee; we build, install and operate the system.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems enable households to use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy.

Our customers are central to that mission. Every home we power is proof that energy independence is possible, and the stories of those homeowners are one of our strongest tools for reaching the next ones.

We are a team of 25 employees across offices in Oslo and Copenhagen. In 2026, we raised a €15 million Series A backed by NordicNinja, Voima Ventures, Lifeline Ventures, Eviny Ventures, Luminar Ventures and Momentum. We're now moving from full-scale pilot to commercial rollout, with the first phase of our production facility coming online in 2027.

The Role

We are looking for a Storyteller to own content creation and community management for our customers. Your main goal is to engage our customers with compelling, on-brand content, and to make Photoncycle something people want to follow, talk about and belong to.

You will shape how Photoncycle shows up on all communications channels, in both Danish and English. That means developing content concepts for social media, writing for our different platforms, and working with external photographers, videographers and agencies to bring ideas to life. You will also be the voice of our brand in our community channels, and you will create moments that bring customers, their neighbours, and future customers together.

Much of this is still unbuilt. Our Danish rollout is in its early phase, so you will spend a considerable amount of time testing formats, trying new ideas, and learning what resonates. We value creativity, curiosity, a structured way of working, and the ability to connect what you create to what the company and the customer actually need, not just the next post in the calendar.

You don't need to be an energy expert from day one. We will support you in learning about the energy markets, and there are experts to help you anytime.

You will join the the small Danish team that is building the market from the ground up, while also contributing to the global storytelling of Photoncycle. You will work closely with operations, product and our marketing colleagues in Oslo to turn a deep-tech product into stories people understand and remember.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and own the content strategy and content calendar across our channels, in Danish and English, tied to clear goals for engagement, awareness and customer loyalty.

• 
Shape the Photoncycle brand story, from our mission to the everyday lives of the homeowners who live with our system.

• 
Develop content concepts and recurring formats for social media that fit how each platform works.

• 
Write copy for our different platforms, including social media, newsletters, website, customer communication, and customer stories.

• 
Brief and manage external partners (photographers, videographers, agencies and freelancers) from concept to final delivery.

• 
Manage our customer community: engage, respond, moderate, spark conversations, and share customer insights with sales, service and product.

• 
Track performance, report on engagement and reach, and use the data to improve what we do.

What We're Looking For

Must-have experience

• 
Experience with concept development, content strategy and creation, brand storytelling or social media, in-house or at an agency.

• 
Excellent written Danish and strong written English.

•

Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 01 February 2026 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics

Research area and project description
The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is inviting applications for a Ph.D. student position focused on the development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in the characterization of foods - Foodomics.

Foodomics is a scientific approach that studies food, nutrition and their effects on health using omics technologies. NMR spectroscopy has played a key role in establishing Foodomics and has offered distinctive insights into foods’ health-promoting potential as well as their functional characteristics. However, ¹H NMR spectroscopy, which is the current workhorse of NMR-based Foodomics, has some analytical limitations. Thus, spectral overlap renders substantial parts of the food metabolome unidentified.

This PhD project aims at developing and examining new and alternative NMR-based approaches within Foodomics. This includes elucidating the potential of ¹³C NMR spectroscopy, which so far has been limited applied in Foodomics. For this purpose, sensitivity-enhancement strategies will be explored, including a dissolution dynamic nuclear polarization technique (d-DNP). This will be done in collaboration with a prominent European d-DNP group.

The PhD project will entail studies on new foods of alternative sources and/or derived from innovative biotechnological processing techniques and solutions.

Tasks and responsibilities include:

• 
Conduct research on development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in food science.

• 
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team including a 4-6-months stay in an international research environment abroad.

• 
Design and implement experiments, collect and analyse data, and interpret results.

• 
Present findings at conferences and publish research in reputable peer-reviewed journals.

• 
Participate in outreach activities to disseminate research outcomes to stakeholders and contribute to teaching in the department

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants must have a relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in chemistry, biotechnology, food technology, or in a related field.

The preferred candidate has substantial hands-on experience in NMR spectroscopy. Relevant expertise in food science, foodomics, multivariate data analysis and good analytical skills is an advantage.

The successful candidate should be motivated to combine laboratory work and experiments, data processing and analysis and ability to work independently and as part of a team in an international research environment.

jobs.description:
Design solutions that solve whole classes of problems rather than individual tasks. As a Senior SRE at Systematic, you keep the systems running that healthcare staff and patients depend on.

Would you like to shape the future of our infrastructure by designing scalable, elegant solutions that solve classes of problems rather than individual tasks? Join our skilled Site Reliability Engineering team where you’ll have the opportunity to think beyond the immediate fix and architect systems that transform how we operate at scale. Your work will keep healthcare solutions running for the clinicians and care staff who depend on them.

The job

As a Senior SRE with a systems engineering mindset, you’ll work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll identify patterns across our diverse infrastructure, from Kubernetes clusters to Azure VMs, and create unified solutions that eliminate entire categories of operational toil. This isn’t about fixing one deployment pipeline; it’s about building a framework that makes all deployments reliable. This isn’t about patching one vulnerability; it’s about architecting a security posture that scales across our organization.

You’ll have access to cutting-edge technologies and the autonomy to innovate, with opportunities to work across multiple environments including our ao-admin Kubernetes cluster, Docker-based deployments, Azure-hosted infrastructure, and healthcare-focused systems. When you are ready, you will join the SRE team’s on-call rotation.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Architect automation systems that eliminate classes of manual work, thinking in terms of platforms and capabilities rather than individual scripts

• Develop infrastructure tooling that empowers development teams to self-service their operational needs while maintaining reliability standards

• Build observability frameworks that provide unified insights across diverse environments, making patterns visible and actionable

• Create abstraction layers that hide complexity while providing powerful capabilities, whether through Terraform modules, Helm charts, or custom operators

• Drive infrastructure evolution by identifying systemic improvements and leading their implementation from concept to production

• Collaborate with development teams to understand their patterns of needs and design operations-ready solutions that scale

• Mentor team members in systems thinking and architectural approaches, sharing your problem-solving methodology

• Apply best practices in site reliability engineering, advocating for solutions that improve reliability, security, and maintainability at scale

• Research and prototype emerging technologies and approaches, evaluating their fit for solving our systemic challenges

Joining the team

You’ll join one of our two skilled SRE teams, each consisting of approximately 10 professionals working from our offices in Aarhus and Bucharest. Our teams operate with a DevOps philosophy and use a mix of Scrum and Kanban methodologies depending on the project needs.

We value engineers who can see the forest and the trees, who understand both the technical details and the broader patterns. You’ll work with colleagues who manage everything from Kubernetes clusters to Windows VMs, from Terraform modules to Prometheus monitoring, and you’ll help us find the common threads that allow us to operate more efficiently and reliably.

This is a role with significant room to manoeuvre and influence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with the newest technologies while solving real operational challenges that impact critical systems across multiple domains. Our healthcare solutions, such as Columna, support the continuum of care across hospitals, communities and private homes, so your work contributes directly to patient safety.

Your qualifications

Our ideal candidate is someone who gets excited about patterns, who sees a specific problem and immediately starts thinking “what other problems does this represent?” You’re the engineer who, when asked to automate a deployment, designs a deployment framework. When asked to fix a monitoring gap, you create an observability strategy.

Our ideal candidate would have:

• Experience as a Senior in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering roles with demonstrated impact on infrastructure scalability

• Solid understanding of abstraction and design patterns in infrastructure, with experience creating reusable frameworks, modules, or platforms

• Experience with observability at scale, including metrics, logging, and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)

• Strong communication skills to articulate architectural decisions, document systems, and mentor others in systems thinking

• Proven ability to architect solutions that solve multiple problems simultaneously, with examples of platforms or systems you’ve built

We value diverse backgrounds and encourage candidates who are passionate about systems thinking, infrastructure architecture, and solving problems at scale to apply, even if they do not meet every requirement perfectly!

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Join us in this role where you’ll develop actionable trading views across European power markets, with a focus on North-West Europe and the UK. Working directly with our Senior Trader on the Revenue Desk, you’ll turn fundamental market analysis into strategic recommendations that shape our hedging and proprietary trading positions on the curve up to 5 years out.

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

**You’ll be part of Price Forecasting & Analysis, a team of dedicated trading analysts and model developers with diverse backgrounds in commodity market analysis, forecasting, and advanced analytics. We have dedicated model developers, so your focus will be on market research and trading support — not building models from scratch.

We value flexibility, experimentation, and knowledge sharing, working in virtual teams with experienced traders, analysts, meteorologists and other specialists. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we especially encourage women and candidates from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• Developing and communicating actionable trading views on European power markets

• Identifying fundamental shifts - supply/demand, policy, weather, interconnector flows - and translating them into trading recommendations

• Collaborating with internal and external analysts to refine market views

• Collaborating directly with the Senior Trader to refine hedging and prop trading strategies

• Performing deep-dive market research on themes that drive power prices across Europe

• Providing fundamental inputs for our price forecasting models and analytics

• Mentoring and educating colleagues on power market dynamics

• Improving our products including price forecasts and trading signal

• Contributing to growing our trading PnL.

**What makes this role stand out:

**

• Direct P&L impact - your recommendations feed straight into trading decisions, not a report that sits on a shelf

• Close to the action - you sit with the trading desk, not in a back-office analytics function

• Green energy trading - your analysis shapes how a global leader in renewable energy trades power

• Ownership - you’ll have the autonomy to drive your own research agenda and trading views

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Have extensive, hands on experience providing trading driven market research and recommendations within power markets, gained in a trading house, power utility, bank, hedge fund or equivalent trading environment

• Have a proven track record of supporting hedging and proprietary trading decisions, with demonstrated impact on positioning and results

• Have deep understanding of European power market fundamentals and their interaction with forwards, options, and curve dynamics

• Have strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to form clear, well reasoned market views under uncertainty

• Have the ability to communicate complex analysis into decisive, trader ready recommendations

• Have a Master’s degree in economics, finance, energy, engineering or a related quantitative field or a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) designation.

**It would be great if you also have:

**

• Experience with North-Western European power markets specifically

• Familiarity with fundamental power market stack modelling concepts

• Experience mentoring or coaching junior analysts

• A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing

• Proficiency in Python and experience with statistical analysis and time series analysis.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.
